fullTextZH: 今天的影片我们来看看台湾人怎么去学校。
fullTextEN: In today's video, let's see how Taiwanese people go to school.
Some Taiwanese people take the bus.

fullTextZH: 但是有很多很多的台湾人骑机车。
fullTextEN: But many, many Taiwanese people ride scooters.
"How do you go out to play?"

fullTextZH: 差不多每个大人（不是小孩），
差不多每个大人都有一台机车。
fullTextEN: Almost every adult has a scooter.

fullTextZH: 所以你会看到很多很多的机车。
fullTextEN: So you will see many, many scooters.

fullTextZH: 为什么台湾人这么喜欢机车呢？
fullTextEN: Why do Taiwanese people like scooters so much?

fullTextZH: 所以很多人不喜欢走路，
fullTextEN: So many people don't like walking,

fullTextZH: 台湾的路都是这个声音，
fullTextEN: Taiwan's roads are all this sound,

fullTextZH: 因为机车，空气变得很脏很臭。
fullTextEN: Because of motorcycles, the air becomes very dirty and smelly.
I think motorcycles are very dangerous.

fullTextZH: 以前很多人骑机车受伤了，
fullTextEN: In the past, many people got injured riding motorcycles,

fullTextZH: 所以台湾政府说：大家骑机车要戴安全帽。
fullTextEN: So the Taiwanese government says: Everyone riding motorcycles must wear helmets.
If you don't wear a helmet,

fullTextZH: 没有戴安全帽会罚 500 块哦。
fullTextEN: Not wearing a helmet will result in a 500 yuan fine.

fullTextZH: 台湾人现在都戴安全帽。
fullTextEN: Taiwanese people all wear helmets now.
No one wants to give 500 yuan.
